result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names and related meta text are truncated in the horizontal carousel and on a popular card, harming readability.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third restaurant name is clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol'), so the full title is unreadable even though the card itself is partially on-screen as expected for a carousel.
issues.suggestion: Allow restaurant name text to wrap to two lines, use a smaller type size, or ensure card width and padding keep the full name visible within each card.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card shows only the promo image and '-20%' badge; the restaurant name, rating, and delivery meta that appear on the card above are missing from the visible portion of this card (beyond simple viewport cutoff of a following section).
issues.suggestion: Ensure each vertical list card includes its title and meta below the image with consistent spacing, or confirm the card structure matches the ramen card above.
